title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: `Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid details.`
preconditions: User is on the login page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/login.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/login.php))
postconditions: User account is created in the database and redirected to login page with a success message.
steps_actions:
1. "Click the \"Daftar\" link on the login page."
2. "Input valid Name, Email, and Password (minimum 8 characters)."
3. "Click the \"Daftar\" button."
steps_result:
1. "The system redirects the user to the registration page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/register.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/register.php))"
2. "All fields accept input without validation errors."
3. "System redirects to login page and displays green notification \"Pendaftaran berhasil, silakan login\"."

title: User Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that an existing registered user can successfully log in with valid credentials.
preconditions: User has a registered account and is on the login page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/login.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/login.php))
postconditions: User is authenticated and redirected to the user dashboard.
steps_actions:
1. "Input registered Email and Password."
2. "Click the \"Login\" button."
steps_result:
1. "Form accepts input without validation errors."
2. "System authenticates user and redirects to dashboard ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php)) displaying \"Halo, [Nama]!\"."

title: User Registration with Invalid Email Format
description: Verify that the registration system blocks form submission when the user inputs an invalid email format.
preconditions: User is on the registration page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/register.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/register.php))
postconditions: Form submission is blocked by browser HTML5 validation and user stays on registration page.
steps_actions:
1. "Input Name, invalid Email format (without domain), and valid Password."
2. "Click \"Daftar\" button."
steps_result:
1. "Form accepts input."
2. "System blocks form submission and HTML5 validation tooltip appears requesting a complete email address."

title: User Registration with Password Under Minimum Length
description: Verify that the registration system rejects account creation when the password is less than 8 characters.
preconditions: User is on the registration page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/register.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/register.php))
postconditions: System reloads page, shows red error alert 'Password minimal 8 karakter', and account is not created.
steps_actions:
1. "Input Name, valid Email, and Password with less than 8 characters."
2. "Click \"Daftar\" button."
steps_result:
1. "Form accepts input."
2. "System reloads page and displays red alert message \"Password minimal 8 karakter\"."

title: User Registration with Already Registered Email
description: Verify that the registration system rejects account creation when using an email address that already exists in the database.
preconditions: User is on registration page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/register.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/register.php)) and email '[agan@gmail.com](mailto:agan@gmail.com)' already exists in database.
postconditions: System reloads page, shows red error alert 'Email sudah terdaftar', and account is not duplicated.
steps_actions:
1. "Input Name, already registered Email, and valid Password."
2. "Click \"Daftar\" button."
steps_result:
1. "Form accepts input."
2. "System reloads page and displays red alert message \"Email sudah terdaftar\"."

title: Log out of the admin account

2. "The admin clicks the \u201cLogout (admin)\u201d button on the admin dashboard ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/admin\/index.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/admin\/index.php))"
steps_result:
1. "The admin successfully logged in and accessed the admin dashboard page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/admin\/index.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/admin\/index.php))"

title: Log out for regular users
description: Ensure that users can log out from the dashboard page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/dashboard.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/dashboard.php))
preconditions: The user is on the login page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/login.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/login.php)) and has logged in to their account using the correct email address and password.
postconditions: Users can log out after logging in, go to the user dashboard page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/dashboard.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/dashboard.php)), and return to the login page.
steps_actions:
1. "The user is on the login page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php)), enters the correct email address and password, and then clicks \u201cLogin.\u201d"
2. "The user clicks the \u201clogout\u201d button on the user dashboard page"
steps_result:
1. "The user successfully logged in and was redirected to the user dashboard page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php))"
2. "The user is redirected back to the login page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php))"

title: Workflow for new users who do not yet have child data
description: Ensure that new users can add child data, place orders, and view order history.
preconditions: The user has logged in and accessed the dashboard with the correct account
postconditions: Users can add child information, add orders for their children, and view their order history.
steps_actions:
1. "Log in with the correct email address and password, then click \u201cLogin\u201d on the Login page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/login.php))"
2. "The user clicks \u201cPlace Order\u201d next to the text \u201cNo orders yet.\u201d"
3. "On the child data page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php)), the message \u201cBelum ada data anak.\u201d appears, and users are prompted to enter the child's information and then click the \u201cTambah Anak\u201d button."
4. "The user clicks the \"Buat pesanan\" menu in the navigation header, selects the child, chooses the uniform size, specifies the quantity, and clicks the \"Pesan\" button."
5. "System processes the order submission."
steps_result:
1. "The user is redirected to the user dashboard page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/dashboard.php)), and the data is still empty, with the message \u201cBelum ada pesanan.\u201d"
2. "The user is redirected to the \u201cBuat Pesanan\u201d page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan_buat.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan_buat.php)), where they see that the child's information is still empty and the message \u201cKamu belum punya data anak.\u201d appears. The user then clicks \u201cTambah data anak dulu.\u201d and is redirected to the \u201cData Anak\u201d page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php))."
3. "The user successfully added a child's information, and the Child List now includes the child who was just added (Nama, Kelas, Aksi)."
4. "The form is submitted successfully without any validation errors."
5. "The user is redirected to the Order History page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php)). A green alert \"Pesanan dibuat. Total Rp 80.000\" is displayed, and the new order appears in the history table with status \"Menunggu Pembayaran\"."

title: Attempt to Place Order Without Registered Child Data
description: Ensure that users who haven't added any child data are prevented from accessing the order form.
preconditions: The user is logged in, but has zero child records registered under their account.
postconditions: The order form is not displayed, and the user is prompted to add child data first.
steps_actions: 1. "Navigate to the Place Order page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan_buat.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan_buat.php))."
steps_result: 1. "The order form is hidden. Instead, a warning message reading \"Kamu belum punya data anak. Tambah data anak dulu.\" is displayed with a working link to the Child Data page."

title: Edit Child Data with Valid Input
description: Ensure that users can edit existing child details (Name and Class) and that changes are correctly saved and updated on the Child Data page.
preconditions: The user is logged in and has at least one child data entry listed on the Child Data page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/anak.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/anak.php)).
postconditions: The child data is updated and reflects the new details on the Child Data page.
steps_actions:
1. "On the child data page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php)), click the \u201cEdit\u201d button next to the name of the child you want to edit in the table."
2. "Modify the \"Nama anak\" and\/or \"Kelas\" fields, then click the \"Simpan\" button."
steps_result:
1. "The user will be redirected to the \u201cEdit data anak\u201d page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak_edit.php?id=](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak_edit.php?id=15)...), where the name and grade will be automatically filled in based on the selected student\u2019s data."
2. "The user is redirected back to the Child Data page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php)), where a green alert message reading \u201cData anak diperbarui\u201d appears, and the updated details are displayed in the list."

title: Delete Child Data via Confirmation Popup
description: Delete the child data that has been created
preconditions: The user has created at least one child record
postconditions: The user successfully deleted the child's data
steps_actions:
1. "On the Child Data page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/anak.php)), click the \"Hapus\" link in the Aksi column for the child entry you want to delete."
2. "Click \"OK\" on the confirmation dialog."
steps_result:
1. "A browser confirmation dialog appears with the message \"Hapus data anak ini?\"."
2. "The page refreshes, a green alert reading \"Data anak dihapus\" appears, and the selected child entry (adul) is removed from the Daftar anak table."

title: Submit Child Data with Empty Name Field
description: Ensure that the system prevents adding a child record when the "Nama anak" field is left blank.
preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Child Data page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/anak.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/anak.php)).
postconditions: Form submission is blocked, and no new record is added to the database or displayed in the table.
steps_actions: 1. "Leave the \"Nama anak\" field blank, select any Class, and click the \"Tambah anak\" button."
steps_result: 1. "An HTML5 validation message reading \"Please fill out this field.\" appears, form submission is blocked, and no new data is added to the table."

title: Edit Child Data with Blank Name Input
description: Ensure that updating an existing child record with a blank name is blocked by the system.
preconditions: The user is on the Edit Child Data page for an existing record ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/anak\_edit.php?id=...](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/anak_edit.php?id=...)).
postconditions: The edit form submission is blocked, and the original child record remains unchanged in the database.
steps_actions: 1. "Clear the \"Nama anak\" field so that it is empty, then click the \"Simpan\" button."
steps_result: 1. "An HTML5 validation popup reading \"Please fill out this field.\" appears, form submission is blocked, and the user remains on the Edit Child Data page."

title: Edit Details of Unprocessed Orders
description: Users can modify an order if its status is still “menunggu pembayaran”
preconditions: pesanan masih dalam status "menunggu pembayaran"
postconditions: The user successfully modified the order

1. "On the page Riwayat Pesanan ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php)), click the \u201cEdit\u201d button in the Actions column for the order you want to edit"

title: Cancel Pending Order with "Menunggu Pembayaran" Status
description: Users can cancel orders they have placed that appear on the Order History page and still have a status of “Menunggu Pembayaran”
preconditions: The user has ordered an item, and the item details have been added to the Order History page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/pesanan.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/pesanan.php)) with a status that is still “Menunggu Pembayaran”.
postconditions: The user has successfully canceled an order whose status has changed from “Menunggu Pembayaran” to “Dibatalkan”.
steps_actions:
1. "The user must be logged in and have at least one order with a status of \u201cMenunggu Pembayaran\u201d on the Order History page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php)), then click \u201cBatalkan\u201d"
2. "Click \"OK\" on the confirmation dialog."
steps_result:
1. "A browser confirmation dialog appears with the message \"Batalkan pesanan ini?\"."
2. "The page refreshes, a green alert reading \"Pesanan dibatalkan\" appears, the order status changes to \"Dibatalkan\", and the action links are replaced with a dash (-)."

title: Place Order with Zero Quantity
description: Ensure that the system prevents users from placing an order when the quantity is set to 0.
preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Place Order page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/pesanan\_buat.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/pesanan_buat.php)).
postconditions: Form submission is blocked, and no new order record is created in the database.
steps_actions: 1. "Select a child, select a uniform size, set the \"Jumlah\" field to \"0\", and click the \"Pesan\" button."
steps_result: 1. "An HTML5 validation popup reading \"Please select a value that is no less than 1.\" appears, form submission is blocked, and no order is placed."
steps_data: 1. "Anak: ellie (Kelas 2), Ukuran seragam: M - Rp 80.000, Jumlah: 0"

title: Place Order without Selecting a Child
description: Ensure that the system prevents users from submitting an order when the child field is not selected.
preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Place Order page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/pesanan\_buat.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/pesanan_buat.php)).
postconditions: Form submission is blocked, and no new order record is created in the database.
steps_actions: 1. "Leave the \"Anak\" dropdown set to \"-- pilih anak --\", select a uniform size, enter a valid quantity, and click the \"Pesan\" button."
steps_result: 1. "An HTML5 validation popup reading \"Please select an item in the list.\" appears, form submission is blocked, and no order is created."
steps_data: 1. "Anak: -- pilih anak --, Ukuran seragam: M - Rp 80.000, Jumlah: 1"

title: Dismiss Order Cancellation via Confirmation Popup
description: Ensure that clicking "Cancel" on the browser confirmation popup keeps the order status unchanged as "Menunggu Pembayaran".
preconditions: The user is logged in and has an order with status "Menunggu Pembayaran" on the Order History page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/pesanan.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/pesanan.php)).
postconditions: The order status remains "Menunggu Pembayaran" and no changes are saved to the database.
steps_actions:
1. "On the Order History page ([http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php](http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/pesanan.php)), click the \"Batalkan\" link for an order with \"Menunggu Pembayaran\" status."
2. "Click \"Cancel\" on the confirmation dialog."
steps_result:
1. "A browser confirmation dialog appears with the message \"Batalkan pesanan ini?\"."
2. "The confirmation dialog closes, and the order status remains \"Menunggu Pembayaran\" with the action links (Edit\/Batalkan) still available."

title: Approve Order Status Progression (Menunggu Pembayaran -> Dibayar -> Diproses -> Selesai)
description: Ensure admin can approve and progress an order through all status states (Menunggu Pembayaran, Dibayar, Diproses, Selesai) with green status alert messages displayed at each step.
preconditions: The tester is logged in as an administrator using admin credentials ([admin@gmail.com](mailto:admin@gmail.com)) on the Admin Orders page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/admin/index.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/admin/index.php)) and an order with status "Menunggu Pembayaran" exists.
postconditions: The order reaches terminal status "Selesai", the action column displays a dash (-), and green success alert banners appear for every status transition.
steps_actions:
1. "Locate a pending order with status \"Menunggu Pembayaran\" and click the \"Jadikan Dibayar\" button."
2. "Click the \"Jadikan Diproses\" button for the same order."
3. "Click the \"Jadikan Selesai\" button for the same order."
steps_result:
1. "A green success alert reading \"Status pesanan #5 diubah ke Dibayar\" appears. The status badge updates to \"Dibayar\", and the action button changes to \"Jadikan Diproses\"."
2. "A green success alert reading \"Status pesanan #5 diubah ke Diproses\" appears. The status badge updates to \"Diproses\", and the action button changes to \"Jadikan Selesai\"."
3. "A green success alert reading \"Status pesanan #5 diubah ke Selesai\" appears. The status badge updates to \"Selesai\", and the action column displays a dash (-)."

title: Filter Orders List by Selected Status Category
description: Ensure admin can filter the order list using the "Filter status" dropdown.
preconditions: The tester is logged in as an administrator using admin credentials ([admin@gmail.com](mailto:admin@gmail.com)) on the Admin Orders page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/admin/index.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/admin/index.php)) with multiple orders under different status categories.
postconditions: The orders table updates to show only records matching the selected status filter.
steps_actions: 1. "Select a status option from the \"Filter status\" dropdown (e.g., \"Menunggu Pembayaran\", \"Dibayar\", \"Diproses\", \"Selesai\", or \"Dibatalkan\")."
steps_result: 1. "The table refreshes\/updates to display only orders matching the selected status filter."

title: Attempt to Access Admin Orders Page Without Admin Authentication
description: Ensure unauthenticated or regular non-admin users cannot access the admin order management page directly via URL.
preconditions: The tester is logged in as a regular user (non-admin account).
postconditions: Access is blocked and an "Akses ditolak" error message is displayed.
steps_actions: 1. "Navigate directly to the Admin Orders page URL: http:\/\/latihan_php.test\/CRUD_php\/admin\/index.php"
steps_result: 1. "Access is blocked and a plain text message reading \"Akses ditolak\" is displayed on the screen."

title: Verify Action Buttons Disabled for Final Order States (Selesai / Dibatalkan)
description: Ensure admin cannot trigger further status changes on orders that have already reached terminal states ("Selesai" or "Dibatalkan").
preconditions: The tester is logged in as an administrator using admin credentials ([admin@gmail.com](mailto:admin@gmail.com)) on the Admin Orders page ([http://latihan\_php.test/CRUD\_php/admin/index.php](http://latihan_php.test/CRUD_php/admin/index.php)).
postconditions: No status update buttons are displayed or accessible for completed or canceled order records.
steps_actions: 1. "Locate order rows in the table that have the status \"Selesai\" or \"Dibatalkan\"."
steps_result: 1. "The \"Aksi\" column displays a dash (-) instead of any action buttons, preventing further state transitions."
